title: Give OLY-9-09 a mechanism linking classes, improvements and roles
summary: Add an athena-core module that joins each repeated failure class to the improvement request that addresses it, and to the role-effectiveness (specialization) and class-trend outcomes. Print it in `athena status` under the existing `repeated` label. Record it as OLY-9-09's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml, with a test that fails without it.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require new unit tests plus workspace cargo test and clippy clean.
Behavior criteria name cargo test commands that check the printed join, not that files exist.
A criterion requires that no repeated causes prints nothing extra.
Reuse existing hestia, class_trend and specialization code; no new crates.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS, StatusView, Records::status, specialization), crates/athena-core/src/class_trend.rs (ClassTrend::analyze/compute/lines), crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs (RepeatedCause, repeated_causes, is_open) and the status display in crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs. Entry point is Records::status, which computes repeated_causes, specialization and class_trend before display prints them. The new module adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not touched.

Existing code: extend crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs RepeatedCause (class, request, landed), crates/athena-core/src/class_trend.rs and the specialization view in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs rather than rebuild them; docs/spec.toml OLY-9-08 and OLY-9-10 already use the repeated and trend labels.

Goal: Athena's owner and the Hestia spec pass need to see feedback classes tied to improvements and role outcomes. The measure keeps the existing label `status: repeated`, which is in STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS.
Consumers: none found for a config change; no athena.toml or defaults.toml edit is needed.
The new join is display-only and adds no refusal rule, so no refusal-rate criterion applies.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-9-09 has mechanism naming the new crates/athena-core module and its function (not "none"), owner "Athena", and a measure ending in `status: repeated`.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core learning`: a fixture with a repeated failure class, a landed addressing request, and a specialization/class-trend outcome yields one line per class that names the class, the request and its landed/open state, and the outcome. The same test fails if the join function is stubbed to return nothing.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`: the status display prints the new lines under the `repeated` label, and prints nothing extra when there are no repeated causes (an empty history is not shown as success).
Run `cargo test` for the workspace, including the xtask spec test that checks the measure marker; it passes.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets`; both are clean.
The diff changes only docs/spec.toml and files under crates/ (the new module, its mod line in lib.rs, status.rs and display.rs wiring), and adds no secrets or personal data.

out_of_scope: Changing other requirements' mechanisms (OLY-9-07, OLY-9-08, OLY-9-10)
departures: Slightly higher p50 cost than the reference, because the change touches core status, the CLI display and the spec.
